svg.desc: Dumbbell chart: The second episode's rise was much larger in the United States and Canada: First episode: OECD aggregate: 2.9, United States: 5.0, Canada: 2.6, Japan: 1.6, France: 2.3, Türkiye: 4.8, Korea: 1.6, Australia: 1.6; Second episode: OECD aggregate: 3.6, United States: 11.3, Canada: 8.4, Japan: 0.7, France: 1.2, Türkiye: 1.5, Korea: 1.2, Australia: 2.3.
